events.factual_description: Birdland Jazz Club presents Coltrane Revisited Centennial Celebration on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, with sets at 7:00 PM and 9:30 PM. Birdland lists Jimmy Greene on tenor and soprano saxophones for September 23, with Helen Sung on piano, Lonnie Plaxico on bass, and Steve Smith on drums. The venue describes the 2026 run as its 25th annual all-star celebration of John Coltrane's music, coinciding with the global centennial of his birth. Birdland lists $45.76-$56.06 for each September 23 set. John Coltrane was born September 23, 1926, making this performance date the exact 100th anniversary of his birth.

en.why_it_matters: Birdland's annual Coltrane ritual lands on the exact centennial this year: September 23 is 100 years to the day after Coltrane's birth, and the room puts Jimmy Greene's tenor/soprano voice over Helen Sung, Lonnie Plaxico, and Steve Smith rather than treating the anniversary as a museum piece. The 25-year continuity of the series gives the repertoire its own live history; the centennial makes this edition unusually resonant.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in play on September 23, actively make room for one of the two sets. From the DMV, I would pair it with another strong New York reason rather than make a dedicated trip solely for this date; Birdland's five-night run and the two centennial-night sets leave some flexibility.

es.why_it_matters: El ritual anual de Birdland alrededor de Coltrane cae este año justo sobre el centenario: el 23 de septiembre son 100 años exactos desde su nacimiento, y la sala pone la voz tenor/soprano de Jimmy Greene sobre Helen Sung, Lonnie Plaxico y Steve Smith, sin tratar el aniversario como pieza de museo. Veinticinco años de continuidad le dan al repertorio una historia en vivo propia; el centenario vuelve esta edición especialmente cargada.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está en juego el 23 de septiembre, sí le haría espacio a uno de los dos sets. Desde el DMV lo combinaría con otra razón fuerte para subir en vez de hacer un viaje dedicado sólo por esta fecha; la residencia de cinco noches y los dos sets del día del centenario dejan margen.
